title: Edge Detection
text: Find edges of objects in images using Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts, or Canny method, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Output Type} sets Output; {Method} sets the edge detection method, {User-defined threshold}, {Threshold source}, {Threshold}, {Threshold, [Low High]} sets the threshold for Canny edge detection, {Threshold scale factor:(used to automatically calculate threshold value)}, {Edge Thinning}, {Approximate percentage of weak edge and nonedge pixels (used to automatically calculate threshold values)} and {Standard deviation of Gaussian filter}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Gv
ports.summary: Gradient responses to vertical edges matrix

ports.name: Gh
ports.summary: Gradient responses to horizontal edges matrix

ports.name: G45
ports.summary: Gradient responses to edges at 45 degrees matrix

ports.name: G135
ports.summary: Gradient responses to edges at 135 degrees matrix

params.name: Method
params.values: Edge detection method Sobel (default) | Prewitt | Roberts | Canny

params.name: Output Type
params.values: Output image type Binary image (default) | Gradient components | Binary image and gradient components

params.name: Threshold source
params.values: Threshold source Input port (default) | Specify via dialog

params.name: Threshold, [Low High]
params.values: Threshold for Canny edge detection [0.25 0.60] (default) | vector

params.name: Threshold scale factor:(used to automatically calculate threshold value)
Approximate percentage of weak edge and nonedge pixels (used to automatically calculate threshold values)
params.values: Approximate percentage of weak edge and nonedge pixels 70 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation of Gaussian filter
params.values: Standard deviation of Gaussian filter 1 (default) | scalar
